sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: When you're a comic book fan, there's always a surge of excitement when they announce a film adaptation of the character you love.
sentences.zh: 作为一名漫画迷，当你喜爱的角色宣布要改编成电影时，心中总会涌起一阵兴奋。

sentences.en: The chance to see your hero punch and twist and leap through the air just makes you giddy.
sentences.zh: 能看到你的英雄在空中挥拳、翻转、跳跃，这简直让你心潮澎湃。

sentences.en: But there's always that fear.
sentences.zh: 但随之而来的总有一种恐惧。

sentences.en: That Hollywood is going to screw it up.
sentences.zh: 担心好莱坞会搞砸它。

sentences.en: That the screenwriter won't get the character the way you get the character.
sentences.zh: 担心编剧无法像你一样理解这个角色。

sentences.en: Because you know how it's supposed to be.
sentences.zh: 因为你很清楚它本该是什么样子的。

sentences.en: You know Mary Jane came after Gwen Stacy.
sentences.zh: 你知道玛丽·简是在格温·史黛西之后出现的。

sentences.en: It doesn't make sense the other way.
sentences.zh: 反过来就不合逻辑了。

sentences.en: But the first indication whether you're going to be buzzing with eager anticipation while you're in line on opening day
sentences.zh: 但第一个预兆决定了你在首映日排队时，是会带着热切的期待兴奋不已，

sentences.en: or dreading each step while you're in line on opening day.
sentences.zh: 还是每走一步都感到提心吊胆。

sentences.en: Because let's face it, you're going to go no matter what.
sentences.zh: 因为说实话，无论如何你都会去看的。

sentences.en: But that first indication of how good or how bad it's going to be happens months before when they reveal the design of the suit.
sentences.zh: 但那个预示电影好坏的第一个信号，早在几个月前服装设计公布时就出现了。

sentences.en: Superhero suits made real with real fabric and real people are very hard to design.
sentences.zh: 用真实的布料和真人来还原超级英雄战衣是非常困难的。

sentences.en: But we will judge them nonetheless.
sentences.zh: 但我们依然会评头论足。

sentences.en: That is our job.
sentences.zh: 这是我们的工作。

sentences.en: Either I've gotten much more mellow over the years or the suits have gotten much, much better.
sentences.zh: 要么是我这些年变得温和了，要么就是战衣真的变好了很多。

sentences.en: Eric Malinsky has noticed this too.
sentences.zh: 埃里克·马林斯基也注意到了这一点。

sentences.en: Eric has done a couple of great episodes for us at 99PI over the years.
sentences.zh: 这些年来，埃里克为我们的《99%隐形》制作过几期很棒的节目。

sentences.en: But now he has his own podcast called Imaginary Worlds.
sentences.zh: 但现在他有了自己的播客，叫《虚构世界》。

sentences.en: About sci-fi and other fantasy genres.
sentences.zh: 专门探讨科幻和其他奇幻题材。

sentences.en: How we create these worlds.
sentences.zh: 探讨我们是如何创造这些世界的。

sentences.en: And why we suspend our disbelief.
sentences.zh: 以及我们为何会产生“怀疑悬置”。

sentences.en: This is an episode that he produced in 2015 about designing comic book costumes for movie screens.
sentences.zh: 这是他2015年制作的一期节目，关于为电影银幕设计漫画服装。

sentences.en: And I really like it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢这期节目。

sentences.en: And I know that you're going to like it too.
sentences.zh: 我知道你也会喜欢的。

sentences.en: It's called Fixing the Hobo Suit.
sentences.zh: 它叫《修复流浪汉战衣》。

sentences.en: Let's not stand on ceremony here.
sentences.zh: 咱们就别客套了。

sentences.en: Mr. Wayne.
sentences.zh: 韦恩先生。

sentences.en: If you haven't seen The Dark Knight Rises.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没看过《蝙蝠侠：黑暗骑士崛起》。

sentences.en: Tom Hardy plays the villain, Bane.
sentences.zh: 汤姆·哈迪饰演反派贝恩。

sentences.en: And for some reason, he did the voice as a cross between Sean Connery and Darth Vader.
sentences.zh: 不知为何，他的配音听起来像是肖恩·康纳利和达斯·维达的混合体。

sentences.en: Given that the character was supposed to come from a fictional Latin American country, it was a very weird choice.
sentences.zh: 考虑到这个角色设定来自一个虚构的拉美国家，这真是一个非常奇怪的选择。

sentences.en: Oh, you think darkness is your ally.
sentences.zh: 哦，你以为黑暗是你的盟友。

sentences.en: You merely adopted the dark.
sentences.zh: 你只是后来才接触黑暗。

sentences.en: But it was so weird, it was kind of amazing.
sentences.zh: 但这太怪了，怪到甚至有点惊艳。

sentences.en: And led to all these really great parodies.
sentences.zh: 并引发了各种各样的精彩恶搞。

sentences.en: Yes, sir.
sentences.zh: 是的，先生。

sentences.en: I believe I would like two packs of Chick-fil-A sauce.
sentences.zh: 我想我需要两包Chick-fil-A酱料。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I don't sound like that.
sentences.zh: 我说话可不是那个调调。

sentences.en: You should have respected my authority.
sentences.zh: 你应该尊重我的权威。

sentences.en: Woo!
sentences.zh: 呜！

sentences.en: But for all the buzz around the voice, I was surprised more people didn't talk about the costume.
sentences.zh: 但尽管关于配音的讨论铺天盖地，我惊讶的是竟然没多少人谈论服装。

sentences.en: Which I thought was ingenious.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那设计简直天才。

sentences.en: So in the comics, Bane looks kind of like a Mexican wrestler.
sentences.zh: 在漫画里，贝恩看起来有点像墨西哥摔角手。

sentences.en: He's got a black hood over his face, with a white design in the middle that kind of looks like a skull with red eyes.
sentences.zh: 他脸上戴着黑色头套，中间有个白色图案，看起来像个红眼睛的骷髅。

sentences.en: His strength comes from tubes going to his back that pump him full of liquid steroids.
sentences.zh: 他的力量来自背后的管子，源源不断地向他体内输送液态类固醇。

sentences.en: In fact, his shoulders are so huge and bulked out, artists like to draw his head below his neck.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他的肩膀太宽太壮了，漫画家们甚至喜欢把他的头画在脖子下面。

sentences.en: There's no way he could do a literal version of that.
sentences.zh: 电影里根本不可能完全照搬那个造型。

sentences.en: But that didn't stop Joel Schumacher from trying in his 1997 catastrophe, Batman and Robin.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有阻止乔尔·舒马赫在他1997年的灾难片《蝙蝠侠与罗宾》中尝试。

sentences.en: Behold!
sentences.zh: 看吧！

sentences.en: The ideal killing machine!
sentences.zh: 理想的杀戮机器！

sentences.en: I call this little number Bane.
sentences.zh: 我管这个小玩意儿叫贝恩。

sentences.en: Of course, Christopher Nolan's Batman took place in kind of a semi-realistic universe.
sentences.zh: 当然，克里斯托弗·诺兰的《蝙蝠侠》系列设定在一个半现实的宇宙中。

sentences.en: So he and Lindy Hemming, his costume designer,
sentences.zh: 所以他和服装设计师琳迪·赫明，

sentences.en: turn Bane's liquid steroids into a gas that he inhales.
sentences.zh: 把贝恩的液态类固醇改成了他吸入的气体。

sentences.en: But it doesn't make him super strong.
sentences.zh: 但这并不会让他变得超强。

sentences.en: It actually dulls physical pain.
sentences.zh: 实际上它只是减轻了身体的疼痛。

sentences.en: His breathing apparatus is the same shape as the design on the hood in the comics,
sentences.zh: 他的呼吸装置形状和漫画里头套上的图案是一样的，

sentences.en: but the breathing apparatus is black and the design on the hood was white.
sentences.zh: 但呼吸装置是黑色的，而漫画里的图案是白色的。

sentences.en: Of course, he's not wearing a hood in the movie.
sentences.zh: 当然，电影里他没戴头套。

sentences.en: Instead, we see the actor's bald head.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们看到的是演员的光头。

sentences.en: So if you squint, Bane's head in that movie looks like the exact same design as the comics,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你眯起眼睛看，电影里贝恩的头部看起来和漫画里的设计如出一辙，

sentences.en: but the negative image of it.
sentences.zh: 只是呈现出负片的效果。

sentences.en: Of course, they couldn't give Bane, like, cartoonishly huge shoulders.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们不能给贝恩装上那种卡通般巨大的肩膀。

sentences.en: So instead, he wore a coat that had a very high, round wool collar
sentences.zh: 所以他穿了一件领口很高、圆形的羊毛大衣，

sentences.en: that gave him the same silhouette as the comic books.
sentences.zh: 这让他拥有了和漫画书里一样的轮廓。

sentences.en: Like I said, it was a brilliant design solution.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，这是一个绝妙的设计方案。

sentences.en: Impossible.
sentences.zh: 不可能。

sentences.en: Superhero costumes used to be cringeworthy.
sentences.zh: 以前的超级英雄服装简直让人尴尬。

sentences.en: Even the cool ones, like, you know, Batman from the Tim Burton filMs.
sentences.zh: 即使是那些看起来很酷的，比如蒂姆·波顿电影里的蝙蝠侠。

sentences.en: The costume was so bulky.
sentences.zh: 那套衣服太臃肿了。

sentences.en: Michael Keaton couldn't turn his head or fight unless the bad guys basically ran into his fists.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·基顿根本没法转头，除非坏人主动撞上他的拳头，否则他根本打不了架。

sentences.en: So what happened?
sentences.zh: 那么后来发生了什么？

sentences.en: How did the costumes get so much better?
sentences.zh: 服装是怎么变得这么好的？

sentences.en: I'm Michael Wilkinson, and I'm a costume designer for filMs.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·威尔金森，我是电影服装设计师。

sentences.en: Michael worked on Man of Steel and the upcoming sequel, Batman vs. Superman.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔参与了《超人：钢铁之躯》和即将上映的续集《蝙蝠侠大战超人》。

sentences.en: He got a lot of heat for the new Batsuit because the first images,
sentences.zh: 他因为新的蝙蝠侠战衣承受了很大压力，因为最初的图片显示，

sentences.en: it looked like Ben Affleck was wearing a thick rubber cowl
sentences.zh: 看起来本·阿弗莱克戴着一个厚重的橡胶头罩，

sentences.en: and wouldn't be able to turn his head, which would feel like a step backwards.
sentences.zh: 而且无法转头，这感觉像是一种倒退。

sentences.en: But newly released images show the Dark Knight turning his head.
sentences.zh: 但最新发布的图片显示，黑暗骑士可以转头了。

sentences.en: I feel like hopefully when the world has a really good look at the cowl that Ben wears,
sentences.zh: 我希望当全世界真正看清本戴的那个头罩时，

sentences.en: I hope people like it because a lot of work went into the construction of that.
sentences.zh: 希望大家会喜欢，因为在制作上投入了大量心血。

sentences.en: There's all sorts of amazing things going on inside that cowl
sentences.zh: 头罩内部运用了各种神奇的技术，

sentences.en: that make it easy to move in and have a full range of expressions.
sentences.zh: 让演员活动起来很轻松，并且能做出丰富的表情。

sentences.en: Superhero costumes used to be just standalone works of fashion,
sentences.zh: 超级英雄服装过去只是独立的时尚作品，

sentences.en: which over time became dated or cringeworthy,
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移变得过时或令人尴尬，

sentences.en: even if they were designed by a genius like Edna Mode in The Incredibles.
sentences.zh: 即使是由《超人总动员》里像埃德娜·摩德那样的天才设计的也一样。

sentences.en: This is a hobo suit, darling.
sentences.zh: 这简直是流浪汉装，亲爱的。

sentences.en: You can't be seen in this.
sentences.zh: 你不能穿这个见人。

sentences.en: I want to allow it.
sentences.zh: 我想保留它。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你什么意思？

sentences.en: You designed it.
sentences.zh: 这是你设计的。

sentences.en: I never look back, darling.
sentences.zh: 我从不回头看，亲爱的。

sentences.en: It distracts from the now.
sentences.zh: 那会分散对当下的注意力。

sentences.en: It will be bold.
sentences.zh: 它会很大胆。

sentences.en: Dramatic.
sentences.zh: 充满戏剧性。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Heroic.
sentences.zh: 英雄气概。

sentences.en: Yeah, something classic.
sentences.zh: 对，要经典一点。

sentences.en: Like Dina Guy.
sentences.zh: 像迪纳·盖一样。

sentences.en: Oh!
sentences.zh: 哦！

sentences.en: He had a great look.
sentences.zh: 他的造型很棒。

sentences.en: The cape and the boots.
sentences.zh: 斗篷和靴子。

sentences.en: No capes.
sentences.zh: 不要斗篷。

sentences.en: One of the big changes is that costume designers
sentences.zh: 一个巨大的变化是，服装设计师们

sentences.en: are now looking more closely at the source material.
sentences.zh: 现在更仔细地研究原始素材了。

sentences.en: When Michael Wilkinson and his collaborator James Atchison
sentences.zh: 当迈克尔·威尔金森和他的合作者詹姆斯·阿奇森

sentences.en: worked on Man of Steel,
sentences.zh: 制作《超人：钢铁之躯》时，

sentences.en: they researched the history behind Superman's costume.
sentences.zh: 他们研究了超人服装背后的历史。

sentences.en: The genesis of that idea was that, you know,
sentences.zh: 这个想法的起源是，你知道的，

sentences.en: the circus performers, the weightlifters,
sentences.zh: 马戏团表演者、举重运动员，

sentences.en: and the strongmen had this look of wearing, you know,
sentences.zh: 还有大力士都有这种穿着，你知道的，

sentences.en: early wool jersey tights with their sort of shorts over the top.
sentences.zh: 早期的羊毛针织紧身衣，外面套着短裤的造型。

sentences.en: So Superman's suit was kind of like a combination of the weightlifter
sentences.zh: 所以超人的战衣有点像是举重运动员

sentences.en: and the ringmaster who wore boots and a cape.
sentences.zh: 和穿着靴子、披着斗篷的马戏团团长的结合体。

sentences.en: Also swashbuckling heroes like Zorro wore capes.
sentences.zh: 此外，像佐罗这样的侠客也穿斗篷。

sentences.en: So James and Michael thought,
sentences.zh: 所以詹姆斯和迈克尔认为，

sentences.en: okay, that still communicates strength, power, adventure.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这依然能传达出力量、权力和冒险的感觉。

sentences.en: But...
sentences.zh: 但是……

sentences.en: How are we going to resolve those silly red underpants?
sentences.zh: 我们该怎么处理那条傻气的红内裤呢？

sentences.en: So we went through dozens and dozens of drawings.
sentences.zh: 所以我们翻阅了数十张草图。

sentences.en: And I remember they pretty much just got smaller and smaller and smaller
sentences.zh: 我记得它们基本上变得越来越小，越来越小，

sentences.en: until one day they just kind of weren't there on the illustration.
sentences.zh: 直到有一天，插画上就干脆没有了。

sentences.en: And that was the look we decided to go with.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们最终决定的造型。

sentences.en: What's the S stand for?
sentences.zh: 那个S代表什么？

sentences.en: It's not an S.
sentences.zh: 那不是S。

sentences.en: On my world, it means hope.
sentences.zh: 在我的星球上，它意味着希望。

sentences.en: Sammy Sheldon Differ had a similar experience working on X-Men First Class.
sentences.zh: 萨米·谢尔顿·迪弗在制作《X战警：第一战》时也有类似的经历。

sentences.en: Now, in the previous X-Men movies,
sentences.zh: 在之前的《X战警》电影中，

sentences.en: the mutants were wearing these sort of black leather outfits
sentences.zh: 变种人们穿着那种黑色的皮质制服，

sentences.en: with just a few distinguishing characteristics.
sentences.zh: 只有极少数的辨识特征。

sentences.en: But the director of First Class, Matthew Vaughn,
sentences.zh: 但《第一战》的导演马修·沃恩，

sentences.en: told Sammy that he wanted to go back to the original comics
sentences.zh: 告诉萨米他想回归最初的漫画，

sentences.en: when the X-Men wore yellow and blue jumpsuits.
sentences.zh: 那时X战警穿着黄蓝相间的连体服。

sentences.en: So, given that, obviously,
sentences.zh: 所以，考虑到这一点，显然，

sentences.en: it's a very simplistic drawing that was on the first cover,
sentences.zh: 第一期封面上画得非常简单，

sentences.en: I just started researching into the period of the time,
sentences.zh: 我开始研究那个时代，

sentences.en: why they were drawn the way they were,
sentences.zh: 为什么他们会被画成那样，

sentences.en: what the colors were representing.
sentences.zh: 那些颜色代表什么。

sentences.en: And what immediately came out was,
sentences.zh: 立刻浮现出的结论是，

sentences.en: in 1963, DuPont discovered Kevlar.
sentences.zh: 1963年，杜邦公司发明了凯夫拉纤维。

sentences.en: It felt to me like maybe that's what they were trying to represent in the comic.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这可能就是漫画里想要表达的东西。

sentences.en: So we kind of went down this route of seeing if that would work for us
sentences.zh: 所以我们沿着这个思路，看看它是否适合我们，

sentences.en: and also what NASA were up to.
sentences.zh: 同时也参考了NASA当时在做的事情。

sentences.en: The advent of the nuclear age may have accelerated the mutation process.
sentences.zh: 核时代的到来可能加速了变异过程。

sentences.en: Individuals with extraordinary abilities may already be among us.
sentences.zh: 拥有非凡能力的人可能已经就在我们身边了。

sentences.en: She pulled it off.
sentences.zh: 她成功做到了。

sentences.en: The costumes look cool.
sentences.zh: 这些戏服看起来很酷。

sentences.en: Very 60s.
sentences.zh: 非常有60年代的感觉。

sentences.en: But honoring the source material is tricky.
sentences.zh: 但要忠于原著素材是很棘手的。

sentences.en: Comic book illustrators, not that they don't understand,
sentences.zh: 漫画插画家们，并不是说他们不懂，

sentences.en: but they don't need to make a logic of the lines that they're drawing,
sentences.zh: 而是他们不需要为自己画的线条建立逻辑，

sentences.en: that where it goes from the front to the back of the body,
sentences.zh: 比如线条从身体前部延伸到后部，

sentences.en: round over the shoulder,
sentences.zh: 绕过肩膀，

sentences.en: it's just what looks cool on the page and sells the dynamic of the character.
sentences.zh: 那只是为了让画面看起来很酷，并体现角色的动态感。

sentences.en: But when you put that into reality,
sentences.zh: 但当你把它变成现实时，

sentences.en: you've got to follow those lines around the body, 360.
sentences.zh: 你必须让这些线条环绕身体，实现360度无死角。

sentences.en: And those characters are wearing skin-tight clothes to show off their ridiculously well-defined muscles,
sentences.zh: 而且这些角色穿着紧身衣来炫耀他们极其发达的肌肉，

sentences.en: which for some reason is completely believable in the comics.
sentences.zh: 这在漫画里不知为何完全令人信服。

sentences.en: One thing we discovered is that no matter what incredible shape an actor is in,
sentences.zh: 我们发现的一件事是，无论演员的身材有多么惊人，

sentences.en: once you put a leotard on them,
sentences.zh: 一旦你给他们穿上紧身衣，

sentences.en: then everything is kind of smoothed out and all that fantastic definition that they've been working so hard at is kind of negated.
sentences.zh: 一切都会变得平滑，他们辛苦练就的那些惊人线条感也就被抵消了。

sentences.en: The next big leap away from cringeworthy costumes was texture.
sentences.zh: 摆脱尴尬戏服的下一个重大飞跃是质感。

sentences.en: Now, in the old days, comic books could only be printed in a few limited colors.
sentences.zh: 在过去，漫画书只能用几种有限的颜色印刷。

sentences.en: That's why the costumes were usually just one or two, maybe three colors, which looked good.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么戏服通常只有一两种，最多三种颜色，看起来还不错。

sentences.en: I mean, they kind of leapt off the page.
sentences.zh: 我是说，它们看起来像是从书页上跳出来一样。

sentences.en: But for a movie like Man of Steel,
sentences.zh: 但对于像《超人：钢铁之躯》这样的电影，

sentences.en: once you get rid of Superman's red underpants and the yellow belt,
sentences.zh: 一旦你去掉了超人的红色内裤和黄色腰带，

sentences.en: the suit is very blue, and that's boring to look at in HD.
sentences.zh: 这套制服就显得非常蓝，在高清画面下看起来很无聊。

sentences.en: So, they created a silver layer that went under the blue to give it a metallic quality.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们创造了一层银色底衬，放在蓝色之下，赋予它金属质感。

sentences.en: And they 3D-printed texture to give it muscle definition.
sentences.zh: 他们还用3D打印技术制作了纹理，以呈现肌肉线条。

sentences.en: And a pattern of ridges, which creates visual interest for lighting and cinematography.
sentences.zh: 还有一种脊状图案，为灯光和摄影创造了视觉趣味。

sentences.en: And they created a backstory to explain that texture.
sentences.zh: 他们还创造了一个背景故事来解释这种纹理。

sentences.en: It was chain mail that went under the armor people wore on the planet Krypton.
sentences.zh: 那是氪星人铠甲下穿的锁子甲。

sentences.en: Another trick, which Sammy Sheldon-Differ likes to use,
sentences.zh: 萨米·谢尔顿-迪弗（Sammy Sheldon-Differ）喜欢用的另一个技巧，

sentences.en: is mixing and matching materials on the same costume.
sentences.zh: 是在同一套戏服上混合搭配各种材料。

sentences.en: With the X-Men costumes, they were layers and layers of fabrics,
sentences.zh: X战警的戏服是由一层又一层的织物组成的，

sentences.en: all worked into and pieced together and then, you know,
sentences.zh: 全部缝合在一起，然后，你知道的，

sentences.en: connecting things one on top of the other.
sentences.zh: 把东西一层层连接起来。

sentences.en: So, if you stand away from them, they just look quite blue with yellow bits.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你站在远处看，它们看起来只是蓝色的，带点黄色。

sentences.en: But actually, when you go in close, it's all kind of intricately stitched to make it textured
sentences.zh: 但实际上，当你近距离观察时，它缝制得非常复杂，以呈现出质感，

sentences.en: and then panels and then leather pieces and then the Kevlar in the middle.
sentences.zh: 还有嵌板、皮革件，中间还有凯夫拉纤维。

sentences.en: Part of design, if it's going to be interesting, is that you have to take risks.
sentences.zh: 设计的一部分，如果想要有趣，就必须承担风险。

sentences.en: And the thing about superheroes, it's a fabulous arena to take risks.
sentences.zh: 而超级英雄电影是一个承担风险的绝佳舞台。

sentences.en: The problem is that these films cost a huge amount of money.
sentences.zh: 问题在于这些电影耗资巨大。

sentences.en: So, you can take the risks, but you better make sure that you come up with the goods
sentences.zh: 所以，你可以冒险，但你最好确保能拿出成果，

sentences.en: because it's an awfully expensive process to get it wrong.
sentences.zh: 因为搞砸了代价极其昂贵。

sentences.en: Yeah, and a lot of very angry fans that will let you know if they don't like it.
sentences.zh: 没错，而且会有很多愤怒的粉丝，如果他们不喜欢，会让你知道的。

sentences.en: Not so much the fans, it's the producers who are still waiting on the set saying,
sentences.zh: 与其说是粉丝，不如说是那些还在片场等着的人，他们会问：

sentences.en: where is it?
sentences.zh: 东西在哪儿？

sentences.en: Finally, it needs to move.
sentences.zh: 最后，它还需要能活动。

sentences.en: James Atchison had a devil of a time working on the first Spider-Man film,
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·阿奇森（James Atchison）在制作第一部《蜘蛛侠》电影时吃尽了苦头，

sentences.en: the one with Tobey Maguire in 2002.
sentences.zh: 就是2002年托比·马奎尔主演的那部。

sentences.en: He spent three months making nearly 70 versions of that suit,
sentences.zh: 他花了三个月时间制作了近70个版本的戏服，

sentences.en: trying to get the colors right, making sure the textured webbing stayed on.
sentences.zh: 试图调准颜色，确保有纹理的蛛网不会脱落。

sentences.en: And when it was finally ready, they took it for a test run.
sentences.zh: 当它终于准备好时，他们进行了测试。

sentences.en: We had a stuntman on a wire, and they flew him straight into a tree, I remember.
sentences.zh: 我记得我们有个特技演员吊着威亚，结果直接撞到了树上。

sentences.en: And the whole suit, I mean, half the webbing unglued from the suit.
sentences.zh: 整套戏服，我是说，一半的蛛网都从戏服上脱落了。

sentences.en: I mean, it was sort of like a terrible waffle hanging in the trees.
sentences.zh: 就像挂在树上的一块糟糕的华夫饼。

sentences.en: It was a disaster.
sentences.zh: 那简直是一场灾难。

sentences.en: It's funny, superheroes are supposed to seem indestructible.
sentences.zh: 很有趣，超级英雄本应看起来坚不可摧。

sentences.en: And maybe there's that scene at the very end where, like,
sentences.zh: 也许在最后会有那么一个场景，比如，

sentences.en: after the superhero's been roughed up, his costume is, like, a little bit torn.
sentences.zh: 在超级英雄被痛打一顿后，他的戏服有点破损。

sentences.en: But in real life, these costumes are extremely fragile.
sentences.zh: 但在现实生活中，这些戏服极其脆弱。

sentences.en: So the solution is to create 20 or 30 versions of the same costume.
sentences.zh: 所以解决方案是制作20到30个版本的同一套戏服。

sentences.en: But each one is tailor-made for the specific needs of each scene.
sentences.zh: 但每一件都是根据特定场景的需求量身定制的。

sentences.en: When Sammy Sheldon Differ worked on Marvel's Ant-Man, even that wasn't enough.
sentences.zh: 当萨米·谢尔顿-迪弗参与漫威的《蚁人》时，即使这样也不够。

sentences.en: The suit has power.
sentences.zh: 这套制服拥有力量。

sentences.en: The man harnesses that power.
sentences.zh: 而使用者驾驭着这种力量。

sentences.en: You should be able to shrink and grow on a dime.
sentences.zh: 你应该能够瞬间变大变小。

sentences.en: So your size always suits your needs.
sentences.zh: 所以你的尺寸总是能满足你的需求。

sentences.en: They want someone to kind of, you know, turn over and over and over.
sentences.zh: 他们想要某人，你知道的，不停地翻滚。

sentences.en: I don't know what you call it, tumbling.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这叫什么，翻筋斗？

sentences.en: And they put in a rubber floor.
sentences.zh: 他们铺了一个橡胶地板。

sentences.en: And then they kind of go, well, he can't do it in these boots.
sentences.zh: 然后他们说，好吧，他穿着这双靴子做不到。

sentences.en: And you have to go, okay, we have to whip up a pair of boots that look identical to the hero pair,
sentences.zh: 你得说，好吧，我们得赶制一双看起来和英雄款一模一样的靴子，

sentences.en: but almost, like, barefoot.
sentences.zh: 但几乎就像赤脚一样。

sentences.en: It's a grueling job.
sentences.zh: 这是一项艰苦的工作。

sentences.en: And Michael Wilkinson says you really need to sort of step back and realize that
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·威尔金森（Michael Wilkinson）说，你真的需要退后一步，意识到

sentences.en: this is really a conversation.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是一场对话。

sentences.en: It's happening across time among designers.
sentences.zh: 它在不同时代的设计师之间进行着。

sentences.en: You know, in Asian art, where over the centuries you take the figure of Buddha or something like that,
sentences.zh: 你知道，在亚洲艺术中，几个世纪以来，你塑造佛像之类的形象，

sentences.en: and over the centuries they are refining, they're putting their own sort of stamp on these cultural figures.
sentences.zh: 几个世纪以来，他们不断完善，在这些文化人物身上打上自己的烙印。

sentences.en: It's kind of like that, I feel, without making it too grand, with our superheroes.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们的超级英雄也是如此，虽然没那么宏大。

sentences.en: Because, you know, each iteration of a superhero, it reflects a lot about the society in which the iteration was born.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，超级英雄的每一次迭代，都反映了该迭代诞生时社会的许多方面。

sentences.en: He's been giving this a lot of thought because he designed the first movie version of Wonder Woman,
sentences.zh: 他对此思考良多，因为他设计了第一部电影版的神奇女侠，

sentences.en: who will appear in Batman vs. Superman.
sentences.zh: 她将出现在《蝙蝠侠大战超人》中。

sentences.en: For Michael, this was a dream assignment.
sentences.zh: 对迈克尔来说，这是一份梦寐以求的工作。

sentences.en: The Wonder Woman, it was super, you know, close to my heart growing up.
sentences.zh: 神奇女侠，你知道，在我成长过程中一直在我心中占据重要位置。

sentences.en: She was the one that really captured my imagination in the strongest way.
sentences.zh: 她是那个最强烈地激发我想象力的人。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: There's something about Linda Carter's performance.
sentences.zh: 琳达·卡特（Linda Carter）的表演有一种特别之处。

sentences.en: They really crossed into this kind of magical world.
sentences.zh: 他们真的进入了这个神奇的世界。

sentences.en: I was fascinated by her backstory.
sentences.zh: 我被她的背景故事迷住了。

sentences.en: And I was lucky enough to actually work with Linda Carter on a film called Sky High,
sentences.zh: 我很幸运能在一部叫《超人高校》的电影里和琳达·卡特合作，

sentences.en: where she played the principal of a high school for superheroes.
sentences.zh: 她在里面饰演超级英雄高中的校长。

sentences.en: So I had a kind of seminal experience shopping with her on Rodeo Drive that I'll probably never really get over.
sentences.zh: 所以我曾有过一次在罗迪欧大道和她一起购物的难忘经历，我可能永远无法释怀。

sentences.en: It was very exciting.
sentences.zh: 那非常令人兴奋。

sentences.en: I mean, I think the reason why costumes have gotten so cool
sentences.zh: 我是说，我认为戏服变得如此酷的原因，

sentences.en: is because the designers are now constantly asking themselves, why?
sentences.zh: 是因为设计师们现在不断地问自己，为什么？

sentences.en: I don't think you can just get away with doing a unitard with a funny helmet.
sentences.zh: 我不认为你只穿一件连体衣戴个滑稽的头盔就能蒙混过关。

sentences.en: I think you have to make sense of why is that person wearing that suit?
sentences.zh: 我认为你必须解释清楚为什么那个人要穿那套制服？

sentences.en: What does he do with it?
sentences.zh: 他用它做什么？

sentences.en: Does he have a power or is it something that the suit gives him?
sentences.zh: 他有超能力，还是这套制服赋予他的？

sentences.en: And then all those questions lead you on to how does that work?
sentences.zh: 然后所有这些问题都会引导你思考它是如何运作的。

sentences.en: That's one of the reasons why I love the new Daredevil series on Netflix.
sentences.zh: 这就是我喜欢Netflix新剧《夜魔侠》的原因之一。

sentences.en: In the first season, there are actually separate episodes to answer all those questions.
sentences.zh: 在第一季中，实际上有单独的剧集来回答所有这些问题。

sentences.en: Why does he need fighting sticks?
sentences.zh: 他为什么需要战斗棍？

sentences.en: Why does he need a padded suit?
sentences.zh: 他为什么需要加垫的制服？

sentences.en: Why does the suit have to be red?
sentences.zh: 为什么制服必须是红色的？

sentences.en: Why does it have horns?
sentences.zh: 为什么它有角？

sentences.en: My grandmother, she was the real Catholic.
sentences.zh: 我的祖母，她是个虔诚的天主教徒。

sentences.en: She used to say, be careful of the Murdoch boys.
sentences.zh: 她常说，小心默多克家的男孩。

sentences.en: They got the devil in them.
sentences.zh: 他们心里有魔鬼。

sentences.en: The evolution of Daredevil's costume becomes the story of the character realizing who he truly is.
sentences.zh: 夜魔侠戏服的演变，成为了角色认清自我真实身份的故事。

sentences.en: The costume is like an expression of his real self,
sentences.zh: 戏服就像是他真实自我的表达，

sentences.en: the one that he has to dig down and find below the surface of his alter ego, Matt Murdoch.
sentences.zh: 那个他必须深入挖掘，在马特·默多克这个伪装身份之下找到的自我。

sentences.en: The best costume designers are storytellers.
sentences.zh: 最好的戏服设计师都是讲故事的人。

sentences.en: The fans will nitpick, but I don't really feel like there are any wrong choices.
sentences.zh: 粉丝们会吹毛求疵，但我并不觉得有什么错误的选择。

sentences.en: So long as they make us believe something that's wonderful and ludicrous at the same time.
sentences.zh: 只要它们能让我们相信某些既美妙又荒谬的事情。

sentences.en: I remember spending many, many, many nights in a loft in Manhattan trying to get the right color screen printed onto those suits.
sentences.zh: 我记得在曼哈顿的一个阁楼里度过了无数个夜晚，试图把正确的颜色丝网印刷到那些戏服上。

sentences.en: So New York is, you know, my favorite city in the whole world.
sentences.zh: 所以纽约，你知道，是我全世界最喜欢的城市。

sentences.en: Oh, that's great.
sentences.zh: 哦，那太棒了。

sentences.en: It's funny, too, because I'm because of those films, those Spider-Man films,
sentences.zh: 也很有趣，因为我，因为那些电影，那些《蜘蛛侠》电影，

sentences.en: when I walk around New York and I've lived here now for 11 years,
sentences.zh: 当我走在纽约街头时，我已经在这里住了11年了，

sentences.en: every so often I look up and I just imagine how great it would be to see Spider-Man swinging through those those canyons of skyscrapers.
sentences.zh: 每隔一段时间我抬头看，就会想象看到蜘蛛侠在摩天大楼的峡谷间穿梭是多么棒。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Seriously, it kind of bums me out that we don't see him up there every so often going,
sentences.zh: 说真的，没能偶尔看到他在上面飞来飞去，让我有点沮丧。

sentences.en: Your no-suit will be finished before your next assignment.
sentences.zh: 你的新制服会在下次任务前完成。

sentences.en: You know I'm retired from hero work.
sentences.zh: 你知道我已经从英雄工作中退休了。

sentences.en: As am I, Robert.
sentences.zh: 我也是，罗伯特。

sentences.en: Yet here we are.
sentences.zh: 但我们还是在这儿。

sentences.en: E, I only need a patch job for sentimental reasons.
sentences.zh: E，我只是因为怀旧才需要修补一下。

sentences.en: Fine.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I will also fix the hobo suit.
sentences.zh: 我也会把那件流浪汉装修好。

sentences.en: You're the best of the best, E.
sentences.zh: 你是最棒的，E。

sentences.en: Yes, I know, darling.
sentences.zh: 是的，我知道，亲爱的。

sentences.en: Fixing the Hobo Suit was produced by Eric Malinsky for his show Imaginary Worlds.
sentences.zh: 《修复流浪汉装》由埃里克·马林斯基（Eric Malinsky）为他的节目《虚构世界》（Imaginary Worlds）制作。

sentences.en: Right now, he's in the middle of a five-part series about the cultural impact of Star Wars.
sentences.zh: 现在，他正在制作一个关于《星球大战》文化影响的五集系列节目。

sentences.en: Of course he is.
sentences.zh: 他当然会这么做。

sentences.en: It's a really great show.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常棒的节目。

sentences.en: Find it at imaginaryworldspodcaSt.org.
sentences.zh: 请访问 imaginaryworldspodcast.org。

sentences.en: So Eric and I both really love the music of Melodium, a.k.a.
sentences.zh: 埃里克和我都很喜欢Melodium的音乐，也就是

sentences.en: Laurent Girard.
sentences.zh: 劳伦特·吉拉德（Laurent Girard）。

sentences.en: Laurent turned 40 this year and released a new Melodium Electro album to celebrate called Friendly Vehicles.
sentences.zh: 劳伦特今年40岁了，为了庆祝，他发行了一张新的Melodium电子专辑，名叫《友好的交通工具》（Friendly Vehicles）。

sentences.en: Right now, that album is pay what you want on Bandcamp, or you can get all 29 of his albums for 88 euros, which is insane to me.
sentences.zh: 现在，这张专辑在Bandcamp上可以随意定价购买，或者你可以花88欧元买下他全部29张专辑，这对我来说简直不可思议。

sentences.en: It's totally worth it.
sentences.zh: 这绝对物有所值。

sentences.en: Make sure you let me know if you buy his whole discography, because you and I should be Twitter friends at the very least if you do that.
sentences.zh: 如果你买了全集，一定要告诉我，因为如果你那样做了，我们至少应该成为Twitter好友。

sentences.en: Get more Melodium in your life at melodium.bandcamp.com.
sentences.zh: 在 melodium.bandcamp.com 获取更多Melodium的音乐。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible is Sam Greenspan, Kurt Kolstad, Katie Mingle, Avery Truffleman, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 《99%隐形》（99% Invisible）的成员有萨姆·格林斯潘（Sam Greenspan）、库尔特·科尔斯塔德（Kurt Kolstad）、凯蒂·明格尔（Katie Mingle）、艾弗里·特鲁夫曼（Avery Truffleman），还有我，罗曼·马斯（Roman Mars）。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 KALW San Francisco and produced out of the offices of ArcSign, the finest architecture and interiors firm in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山91.7 KALW电台的一个项目，在加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心美丽的ArcSign建筑与室内设计公司办公室制作。

sentences.en: You can find this show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Facebook上找到并关注这个节目。

sentences.en: We're all on Twitter, Tumblr, Instagram, and Spotify, but you can listen to every single episode of 99% Invisible at 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 我们都在Twitter、Tumblr、Instagram和Spotify上，但你可以在 99pi.org 收听《99%隐形》的每一集。
